title: Podcast Walkthrough
subtitle: Move an episode from source to published assets

scenes.caption: Open Podcast and show the workflow tracker.
scenes.narration: Podcast keeps an episode moving from source to final assets. It tracks transcript, packaging, clips, approvals, publishing, and final verification.

scenes.caption: Show the workflow gates and approval idea.
scenes.narration: The important part is control. Each step has a place, and publishing should not happen until the right approval gate is complete.
